fix_subject: Fix several integer overflows in hugeint add/subtract
pr_title: Fix several integer overflows in hugeint add/subtract

labels.summary: Hugeint AddInPlace and SubtractInPlace could perform signed 64-bit overflow in intermediate expressions when computing the upper word, so the operations are restructured to apply the overflow or underflow carry only after the range checks pass.
